title: Chapter 398 Zhao Bangde Is Injured
content:
Chapter 398 Zhao Bangde Is Injured

But the crocodile man didn't seem to feel well either. He took two steps back. Judging from his frivolous steps, he was obviously seriously injured.

However, Wang Shuo was even more confused. He had no weapons, so what could he do?

"Fuck!"

He was just about to avenge his previous shame, but suddenly found that he had no weapon to use.

This really made him uncomfortable.

Fortunately, Ye Tianba still carried a gold-level spear with him.

"Lord, take it."

Ye Tianba threw the spear in his hand to Wang Shuo, and then he took out a spare one.

Although it was not suitable, it was a gold-level spear after all, so it could still be used.

Wang Shuo immediately launched a crazy attack on the crocodile man.

Now the situation was very favorable, Wang Shuo was no longer timid, and his moves were open and closed, and extremely fierce.

The crocodile man was beaten back step by step. As the saying goes, if you defend for a long time, you will lose.

Wang Shuo seized the opportunity and stabbed the crocodile man in the abdomen.

Then, a move of "dragon out of the sea" exploded on the crocodile man's stomach.

At this point, the winner was decided.

Wang Shuo stepped forward and struck, ending the crocodile man's life.

He took out a demon pill from his head.

Just when Wang Shuo was about to go up and help Zhao Bangde, Zhao Bangde stopped him with his eyes.

Although Wang Shuo had doubts in his heart, he did not show them.

He turned to deal with other demon beasts.

After a while, Wang Shuo heard a huge explosion.

Looking back, it was Zhao Bangde and Apache, fighting each other.

Zhao Bangde flew backwards and hit several soldiers, and a large mouthful of blood spurted out of his mouth.

He swallowed hard, but couldn't help it and spurted out another mouthful of blood.

Wang Shuo was shocked! He hurried over.

"Old Zhao, are you okay!"

Zhao Bangde was about to speak weakly, but suddenly fainted.

Wang Shuo was furious and gnashed his teeth.

He immediately asked the surrounding generals who still had the water of life.

Gong Zheng just had one drop left, so Wang Shuo gave it to Zhao Bangde, but Zhao Bangde still didn't wake up.

Wang Shuo immediately raised his gun, pointed it at Apache's head, and released a move called "Dragon Out of the Sea".

A dragon-shaped phantom ran straight to Apache and bit him on the head.

Apache was a platinum boss with extremely strong defense. Although he was injured, Wang Shuo couldn't hurt him easily.

A layer of golden light appeared on Apache's body, resisting the attack.

Wang Shuo was not discouraged, and continued to attack Apache fiercely.

In the sky far away, the Black Dragon King who was secretly observing found that Zhao Bangde was injured and unconscious, and he was secretly happy.

"Haha... God really helps me!"

"Pass my order, the whole army will attack the human race and unify the Dahuai region."

In an instant, the army of undead, like locusts, spread from the right side of the Great Wall to the left side where the human race was.

The soldiers on the Great Wall were planning to celebrate their victory over the monsters.

But they didn't expect the undead to suddenly turn against them. They were caught off guard and panicked.

They just ran for their lives!

At this time, the four commanders of Shanhai City stood up and immediately organized people to resist.

The soldiers immediately found their backbone and began to fight the undead inside and outside the Great Wall.

Zhu Dongheng also rushed to the battlefield quickly. When he passed by Wang Shuo, a sword energy was released, breaking the defense of the seriously injured Apache.

Apache, who was struggling to hold on, spurted out another mouthful of blood. Wang Shuo seized the opportunity and finally shot him in the head.

Apache, the supreme commander of the monster army, died.
